# MacCracken — Recognizing Recognition (2017)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** Sean MacCracken, “Recognizing Recognition: Utpaladeva’s Defense of Śakti in His ‘Proof of Relation’ (*Sambandhasiddhi*),” *Religions* 8, no. 11 (2017): 243, https://doi.org/10.3390/rel8110243.

**Shortened note:** MacCracken, “Recognizing Recognition,” 1–2.

**Bibliography:** MacCracken, Sean. “Recognizing Recognition: Utpaladeva’s Defense of Śakti in His ‘Proof of Relation’ (*Sambandhasiddhi*).” *Religions* 8, no. 11 (2017): 243. https://doi.org/10.3390/rel8110243.

## Essay use

This open-access study locates a Buddhist/Śaiva dispute over relation and the constructible (*vikalpa/kalpanā*) in its own historical argument. It gives §0/#2 a counterpressure against silently treating Buddhist conceptual construction, Śaiva Śakti, and the essay’s constructive world-gathering as one doctrine.

**Claim boundary:** it does not define *saṃkalpa* for §0, prove the essay’s QL cut/composition relation, or establish a computational process ontology.
